name: Example Message Mod
description: Phase 4.4 fixture — a native mod that exercises both message-row mount points: adds a 'tag' action button to every message's action rail (message.actions) and renders a one-line annotation beneath every message (message.below). Used to prove per-message chrome and content mounts work end-to-end. Disable it from Extensions to verify teardown is clean.
